# 5. Interaction Flow

## 5.1. Overall Flow

For L4, the typical integrated model for home broadband service assurance is depicted in the following figure. Which involves the network autonomous domain automatically completing functions such as experience-related indicators' definition, poor QoE identification based on KPIs, remediable solutions' generation, remedy operation execution within a single domain, and automatically reporting to OSS/cross-domain the list of users requiring on-site repairs, along with repair recommendations for each user. [Figure: Figure 6. Interaction Flow for Fixed Access Network Planning and Design Scenario Solution Package]

To achieve end-to-end intelligentization of FTTX networks driven by LLMs (Large Language Models)—from automatic planning and AI design (HLD/LLD) to 3D digital twin surveying, construction, and automatic synchronization—a highly integrated, and intelligent technical foundation must be established.

The following are the key prerequisites required to realize this vision:

| Dimension | Key Prerequisites | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data and Knowledge Foundation | Multi-source Heterogeneous Data Integration | High-quality, standardized data covering resources, users, geography, economy, etc. |
|  | Domain Knowledge Base and Expert System | Structured storage of planning rules, design specifications, device parameters, and other domain knowledge for LLM invocation. |
| Technical Platform and Toolchain | Telecom Domain Fine-tuned LLM | Trained on professional corpora, capable of understanding network language and multimodal data, and generating compliant solutions. |
|  | AI and Optimization Algorithm Library | Integrates routing optimization, resource allocation, predictive algorithms, etc., for automated design. |
|  | 3D Digital Twin Platform | Capabilities for high-precision modeling, real-time data synchronization, and simulation verification, enabling visual design and construction. |
|  | Integration and Automated Workflow Engine | Connects the entire process from planning, design, construction, to resource updates, enabling automatic task triggering and flow. |
| Standardization and Interfaces | Data Interface Standardization (API) | Defines unified APIs to ensure seamless data interaction between systems (planning, design, digital twin, resources, network management). |
|  | Model and Design Output Standardization | Ensures HLD/LLD output formats are machine-readable and parsable for automated execution. |
| Organization and Process Transformation | Cross-Domain Collaborative Team | Agile teams composed of planning engineers, AI experts, 3D modelers, software developers, etc. |
|  | Process Reengineering and Role Evolution | Restructures construction processes; shifts engineer roles toward demand analysis, rule formulation, solution review, and exception handling. |
| Infrastructure and Investment | Powerful Computing Support | Cloud computing/HPC resources to support LLMs, simulation, and complex computations. |
|  | Reliable Network Connection | High-speed, low-latency network to support real-time data interaction between survey terminals and platforms. |
